278411112.description:
Texo
Smoking Pipe, Blue & White Ceramic Floral Pattern
7 Inches Long
A vintage smoking pipe featuring a ceramic bowl decorated with a blue and white scroll motif reminiscent of traditional Delftware styles. The pipe is constructed with a curved dark stem and a metal ferrule marked "TEXO". This piece serves as a distinctive collectible for tobacco enthusiasts and collectors of ceramic smoking accessories.
Ceramic bowl with blue floral scrollwork and a crackle glaze finish
Metal ferrule transition between bowl and stem, stamped with "TEXO" mark
Curved dark stem with a tapered bit for comfortable use
Approximately 7 inches in overall length
Condition:
The ceramic bowl exhibits all-over glaze crazing typical of aged ceramic pipes. The interior of the bowl shows charring and residue from previous use. The metal ferrule shows a natural patina and light surface wear. The stem is intact with minor surface scuffs but no visible cracks.
